changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Standalone function with no dependencies. Returns List[str] for use by extract_patterns().

changesApplied.changeMade: Implemented pattern identification for error types (TypeError, ValueError, etc.), code smells (duplicate code, long method), refactoring patterns (extract method, rename), and task types (fix bug, add feature, refactor, test, docs).
changesApplied.reason: Specification requires detection of recurring patterns across messages. Enables learning from common error types and refactoring patterns.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Standalone function with no dependencies. Returns List[str] for use by extract_patterns().

changesApplied.reason: Specification requires complexity indicators to assess scope of changes. Helps prioritize and categorize activities.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Standalone function with dependencies on extracted file_paths and components. Returns Dict[str, Any] for use by extract_patterns().

changesApplied.changeMade: Implemented GET endpoint with query parameters: session_id (optional filter), pattern (optional keyword filter), limit (1-100, default 10), offset (pagination). Queries get_mapping_records(), extracts patterns from messages, returns List[ImpulseMappingResponse]
changesApplied.reason: Specification requires GET /v1/learning/impulse-mappings endpoint to expose pattern extraction via API. Enables clients to query historical patterns.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: New endpoint. No impact on existing endpoints. Depends on impulse_learning.get_mapping_records() and pattern_extraction_service.extract_patterns(). Adds new route to learning_loop router.

flow_steps: Client sends GET request with query params (session_id, pattern, limit, offset)
Endpoint validates parameters using FastAPI Query validation
Endpoint calls get_mapping_records(session_id, limit, offset) to fetch records from SurrealDB
Endpoint filters records by pattern keyword if provided
For each record: extract messages (user message, context files)
Build ImpulseMappingResponse with record data + PatternData
Return List[ImpulseMappingResponse] as JSON to client
dataFlowIntegrity.schema_consistency: All data transformations preserve types. Messages (List[str]) -> PatternData -> ImpulseMappingResponse.extracted_patterns
validation_points: Pattern filter applied to normalized_pattern field
extract_patterns handles empty messages gracefully (returns empty PatternData)
All regex patterns include error handling for malformed input
